	option = {

			NOT = { check_variable = { party_pop_array^3 > 0.29 } }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } } } set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 2 } change_ruling_party_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.05 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.05 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_FRA_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = {
				id = COLDWAR_FRA_bop
				value = 0.05
				tooltip_side = COLDWAR_FRA_bop_europe_side
			}
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_bop_value = 0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_FRA_bop_value min = -1 max = 1 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_FRA.1.b
		trigger = {
			OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_FRA.1 option b"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } } } set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 1 } change_ruling_party_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.03 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.03 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_FRA_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = {
				id = COLDWAR_FRA_bop
				value = -0.05
				tooltip_side = COLDWAR_FRA_bop_grandeur_side
			}
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_bop_value = -0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_FRA_bop_value min = -1 max = 1 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_FRA.1.c
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { party_pop_array^3 > 0.29 }
			OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_FRA.1 option c"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } } set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 3 } change_ruling_party_effect = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.05 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.05 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_FRA_unrest_m5_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest_delta = -5 }
			COLDWAR_FRA_unrest_change = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_FRA.1.e

			NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } } }

		add_stability = -0.02
